result.rationale: Verified in the diff: addGuests.schema.ts defines ZAddGuestsInputSchema as z.array(z.string().email()) with no uniqueness refine, and addGuests.handler.ts's uniqueGuests filter only compares against booking.attendees and the blacklist, not against other guests in the request. So duplicated emails within one request pass both checks and createMany inserts duplicate attendee rows; client-side refine is not enforcement.

judged_text: The server-side schema (addGuests.schema.ts:6) lacks the intra-list uniqueness check that the client enforces: ZAddGuestsInputSchema is just z.array(z.string().email()) and the handler's filter (addGuests.handler.ts:71-75) only removes emails already on the booking, never deduplicating within the request. So guests: ["a@x.com", "a@x.com"] passes both filters and hits createMany twice, creating duplicate attendee rows (same for concurrent requests due to check-then-act with no transaction/lock). Client-side validation is not enforcement.
